Name: GUI Blocking
Description: The generation of animations must not block execution of the GUI.

Name: Progress Bar
Description: The system should display a progress bar when generating animations.

Name: Animation Preview
Description: The system should offer the user the option to view a lower quality preview of the animation they are generating.

Name: Complex State
Description: The system must include a GUI state for configuring multi-operation animations.

Name: Saving Animation Configs
Description: The system should allow the user to save animation configurations to the disk.

Name: Loading Animation Configs
Description: The system should allow the user to load previously saved animation configurations from the disk.

Name: Save Format
Description: The system should use it's own XML format to store saved animation configurations.

Name: Floating Point Arithmetic
Description: The system should support floating point numbers for all animations.
